label: Travel Agent
blurb: Plans a trip from the places already in your brain, draws it on the Map, and shops it on public sites — stopover nights included. Books nothing.

suggestions.short: Read my places first and propose my taste; ask only what the brain cannot know — airports, passports, companions, pace, budget.
suggestions.q: Set up or update my travel profile. Read my places first — what I saved, rated and visited — propose my taste from them, and only ask me what the brain cannot tell you: home airports, citizenships, who I travel with, pace and budget.

suggestions.short: Three ideas from my brain alone — cities I saved and never visited, places I loved, people I know there.
suggestions.q: Where should I go next? Use only my brain — cities where I saved places and never went, places I rated highly, people I know — and give me three ideas, each with the notes that justify it and the months I usually travel.

suggestions.t: Plan a trip from my places
suggestions.short: Five days built from my own pins, one walking route a day, drawn on the Map.
suggestions.q: Plan five days in the city at the top of my trip ideas, built from my own saved places first. Put it on the map with one walking route per day, and tell me which suggestions came from my brain and which are web only.

suggestions.short: The kind of places I love in a city I name, with reviewers’ own words as evidence — on the Map.
suggestions.q: Find the best-reviewed places of the kind I love in a city I name — search Google Maps, read the reviews against my own taste, and give me the ones reviewers describe the way I would, with their words as evidence. Put them on the map.

suggestions.short: Real prices for the current trip, read in my browser; a long layover becomes a night in that city, risk spelled out.
suggestions.q: Find real flight prices for the current trip from my home airport — Google Flights first, then the carriers' own sites — and show them as a flights list. If two separate tickets with a long layover are cheaper, turn the layover into a night in that city, with the self-transfer risk spelled out. Book nothing.

suggestions.short: Stays for each stop where that stop’s places cluster, matched to my hotel style, with real prices.
suggestions.q: Find stays for each stop of the current trip with real prices and availability — Google Hotels, then Booking.com and Agoda — in the neighbourhood where that stop's places cluster, matched to my hotel style. Show them as a hotels list, with what recent reviews say about what I care about. Book nothing.

suggestions.short: Cafés and restaurants near each day’s route that match the places I rated highly.
suggestions.q: For the current trip, find cafés and restaurants that match my taste — the kinds of places I rated highly — near each day’s route. Keep my own saved places first and mark anything that is web only.

settings.title: Travel Agent settings
settings.blurb: The Travel Agent draws your trips on Studio's Map. The Map needs your own Google Maps key — it stays in this browser or app and goes only to Google to load map tiles, never your notes. Planning and every trip note work without it.
